decision_summary.title: Retirement of External Custody Blocker from Engineering Development
decision_summary.rationale: Independent third-party custody protocols (RCA-2A.14a/b) are valuable for high-assurance certification, but in a solo-developer codebase they create an artificial roadblock against practical Agent v0 implementation. Engineering validation is unblocked while keeping formal qualification protocols safely deferred.

tier_1_development_regression.scope: Deterministic unit tests, safety invariants, regression suites, historical fix verification.
tier_1_development_regression.dataset_type: Exposed development fixtures (e.g. F1-F4), synthetic unit mocks, deterministic replay.
tier_1_development_regression.independence_requirement: None (fully automated within developer CI/local test runners).
tier_1_development_regression.authority: Guarantees code safety, schema integrity, and non-regression of past bugs.

tier_2_solo_engineering_validation.scope: Developer-authored novel cases, exploratory A/B model comparisons, heuristic & manual semantic reviews, architectural benchmarking.
tier_2_solo_engineering_validation.dataset_type: Synthetic evidence cases across Q1-Q6 families, developer-controlled test scenarios.
tier_2_solo_engineering_validation.independence_requirement: Non-independent. Must explicitly disclose that developer and evaluator share the same identity; cannot claim double-blindness.
tier_2_solo_engineering_validation.authority: Provides empirical directional evidence to guide prompt design, error handling, and orchestration architecture.

tier_3_independent_qualification.scope: Formal release qualification with independent custody, novel sealed holdout cases, and blinded third-party adjudicators.
tier_3_independent_qualification.dataset_type: Cryptographically sealed, unexposed holdout batteries managed by external custodians.
tier_3_independent_qualification.independence_requirement: Strict 5-role custody matrix and independent storage boundary.
tier_3_independent_qualification.authority: Authorizes default production deployment in zero-trust environments. DOES NOT block Tier 1 or Tier 2 progress.
